metadata.title: Real-mode FinOps review of existing Azure landing zone (offline AgentResult scorer)

architectureBrief.systemName: Contoso Enterprise Landing Zone (year-3 steady state)
architectureBrief.description: Mature hub-spoke deployment supporting ~400 workloads; leadership requests a zero-architecture-change cost optimization pass.
technologyStack: Hub VNet with Azure Firewall Premium
reviewObjectives: Find idle or oversized compute without reliability regressions
Rationalize storage tiers and orphaned disks
Attribute shared egress and firewall costs to spokes
constraints: No production topology changes during fiscal quarter close
Reserved instance commits require CFO approval >$50k/year
Tags mandatory on all non-decommissioned resources

inputSummary: Existing hub-spoke Azure estate with App Service plans, storage, and shared egress FinOps tagging. Synthetic cost-optimization drill distinct from modernization lift-shift case.

qualityEvidence.notes: Committed Cost-shaped exemplar for RC quality gate parity.
